note: Findings of tools/guard/lint-target-use.mjs that have been reviewed and allowed. Each entry: key (from --json), file, rule, reason, approvedBy.

allow.reason: fitMix chooses a 1-3 pan box mix for a set of cells from the set's mean colour against the sheet's mean colour there: a mix choice at shape level, not a mark kept for lowering error. It runs only with --passages treelayers, not in any default run.
allow.approvedBy: anti-cheat review (bench/docs/anti-cheat.md): a shape-level mix choice is allowed

allow.reason: --drags charges each drag from DRAG_TARGET, a copy of the target plan. Not allowed: sealed at beginPaint, so a --drags run fails in gentle and hard. No benchmark or default run sets --drags; delete with it (overfit-audit rows 21, 33).
allow.approvedBy: 033-honest: listed only; the runtime guard blocks this read in gentle and hard (tools/guard/seal-maps.mjs)

allow.reason: --skywarm splits sky passages by the target's red minus blue per cell at paint time. Not allowed: SKY_WARM_RB is sealed where it is made, so a --skywarm run fails in gentle and hard. No benchmark or default run sets it; restate it at planning or delete.
allow.approvedBy: 033-honest: listed only; the runtime guard blocks this read in gentle and hard (tools/guard/seal-maps.mjs)

allow.reason: --texture 1 places dry-brush marks from HP, a per-cell high-pass of the target, at paint time. Not allowed: HP is sealed at beginPaint, so a --texture 1 run fails in gentle and hard.
